name: @mariozechner/pi-web-app
description: Next.js graphical interface for the pi coding agent harness

scripts.dev: npm run build:deps && npm run dev:app
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npm run build:app
scripts.build:deps: cd ../tui && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.check: cd ../.. && biome check --write --error-on-warnings packages/web-app/app packages/web-app/components packages/web-app/lib && cd packages/web-app && tsgo --noEmit

author: Mario Zechner
